perform.hint: Turn pages with PageDown/PageUp, arrow keys, Space, or by tapping the right/left half of the screen. Press L for the piece list, Esc to leave.
perform.empty: This show has no pieces yet
perform.skipped: {count} pieces could not be opened and will be skipped
perform.noneOpenable: None of the pieces can be opened
perform.wrongTeam: This show does not belong to the team in the link
perform.unavailable: This piece could not be opened

bar.unsupported: This browser does not support audio playback (Web Audio).
bar.empty: The score is empty, there are no notes to play.
bar.optionsCustom: Playback options (some settings differ from the defaults)

chords.title: Chord accompaniment
chords.carry: Repeat the chord in measures without one
chords.carryOn: Measures without a chord repeat the chord in effect at the start of the measure.
chords.carryOff: Measures without a chord stay silent; chords only play where they are written.
chords.note: Adjust the accompaniment volume in the Mixer (the "Chords" row).

loop.title: Loop section A-B
loop.marks: Set points A and B at the current measure
loop.needBoth: Set both A and B to turn looping on
loop.needBothNote: Set both A and B to turn looping on.
loop.countInTitle: Count in one measure with clicks before each pass
loop.speedUpTitle: Each pass gets 5% faster up to 100%, starting from the selected speed
loop.unreachable: This section is not played in the score's repeat order, so it cannot be looped yet.
loop.dragHint: Tip: hold Shift and drag across the measures (or Shift-click two measures) to pick a section.

mixer.label: Staff mixer
mixer.single: The score has only one staff
mixer.hint: Mute, solo a staff, adjust the volume
mixer.soloActive: Only the soloed staves are playing

transpose.label: Transpose
transpose.title: Transpose while listening
transpose.outOfRange: {count} notes outside the piano range will be skipped during playback.
transpose.listening: Listening at {value} semitones. The score here stays unchanged so you can edit it.
transpose.rewrite: The score will be rewritten in the new key ({key}). {hint}

notFound.title: Score not found
notFound.text: The score does not exist or you do not have permission to view it.

notReady.title: The score is not digitized yet
notReady.text: The score has no MusicXML to play yet. Wait for recognition to finish or check the progress page.

parseError.title: Could not read the score
parseError.text: The MusicXML file is broken, so it cannot be played.

scorePlayer.invertTitle: Invert score colors (dark background, light notes)
scorePlayer.parseForTranspose: Could not read the score to transpose it
scorePlayer.applyHint: This is saved right away as a new version of the score.

conflict.title: The score was just saved elsewhere
conflict.known: The server already has version {latest}, newer than the one you are listening to (version {version}). Load the latest version and transpose again.
conflict.unknown: The server already has a newer version than the one you are listening to. Load the latest version and transpose again.
